title: 原创翻译练习
description: 仿四级段落翻译的高频句式，逐句练习中译英。提交后对照参考译文自评。

questions.stem: 随着互联网的普及，越来越多的人选择在网上购物。
questions.answer: With the popularity of the Internet, more and more people choose to shop online.
questions.analysis: “随着……的普及”常用 with the popularity of；“越来越多的人”可用 more and more people。注意时态用一般现在时。

questions.stem: 我们应该保护环境，因为它是我们共同的家园。
questions.answer: We should protect the environment because it is our common home.
questions.analysis: 两句之间用 because 连接表示原因；“共同的家园”译为 our common home。

questions.stem: 学习英语不仅需要记忆单词，还需要大量的练习。
questions.answer: Learning English requires not only memorizing words but also a lot of practice.
questions.analysis: “不仅……还……”用 not only ... but also ...；“记忆单词”可用 memorizing words。

questions.stem: 近年来，人工智能技术发展迅速，已经改变了我们的生活方式。
questions.answer: In recent years, artificial intelligence technology has developed rapidly and has changed the way we live.
questions.analysis: “近年来”用 in recent years，搭配现在完成时；“生活方式”译为 the way we live 或 our lifestyle。

questions.stem: 只有通过不断的努力，我们才能实现自己的目标。
questions.answer: Only through constant effort can we achieve our goals.
questions.analysis: “只有……才……”可用 only 置于句首的倒装结构：Only through ... can we ...；“实现目标”译为 achieve our goals。
